subject: Strategy: Pillar realignment + interim role adjustments (Q3 prep)
body:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Partner Ops <partners@integrate.io>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Strategy: Pillar realignment + interim role adjustments (Q3 prep)

Team —

Sharing a first-pass communication for the leadership group about a light organizational realignment we're planning to announce during QBR week. This is intentionally targeted: the change focuses on consolidating two adjacent product pillars (Platform & Serving) into a single "Serving Platform" pillar and making short-term adjustments to a few people leads to speed decision cycles while we validate OKR mappings.

High-level asks from recipients:
- Laura: review tone for TL;DR for the company (aim for 3 bullets).
- Vivek: confirm operational impacts (on Dedicated and Private roadmap timelines).
- Neha: flag any HR/comp implications and recommended talking points for managers.

Attachments: org_chart_v2.pdf (draft), pillar_okrs_mapping.xlsx (workbook).

Draft communication below — please focus on accuracy, clarity, and answers to the asks above.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:01:12 -0700
Subject: DRAFT: Leadership note — Pillar consolidation and interim leads

Hello Redwood colleagues,

As part of our Q3 priorities and to remove overlap between closely related product workstreams, we plan to combine the Platform and Serving pillars into a single Serving Platform pillar. This alignment will: 

- Reduce cross-pillar dependencies for low-level runtime work
- Increase end-to-end accountability for performance and cost optimizations
- Help us move faster on integrated product initiatives (e.g., caching, routing policies, shared infra)

In the short term (interim through the end of the quarter), we will appoint interim pillar leads so the team has a clear escalation path while we complete role clarity and hiring where needed. We expect to share the updated org chart and OKR mapping by next week.

Why now: our QBR assessment called out repeated hand-offs on latency/cost work that slowed deliveries; consolidating oversight should reduce iteration cycles and clarify ownership.

What changes for individuals: most contributors' day-to-day work will not change. Managers will receive specific guidance and talking points to discuss with their teams.

We will run a manager briefing next Tuesday (calendar invite forthcoming). Please review the attached org chart and the OKR map and send feedback by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: org_chart_v2.pdf (PDF, 160KB)]
[Attachment: pillar_okrs_mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 240KB)]

----------------------------------------

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy: Pillar realignment + interim role adjustments (Q3 prep)

Vanessa —

Nice and concise. My suggested edits for the company-facing TL;DR:

1) We are consolidating Platform + Serving into "Serving Platform" to speed product decisions.
2) Expect clearer ownership for performance and cost improvements; most contributors' work stays the same.
3) Managers will receive talking points and an updated org chart next week.

Tone note: make the second paragraph a bit shorter and remove the word "hand-offs" — sounds negative; use "coordination gaps" instead.

Also: suggest adding one sentence about how this supports customers (reduce latency, more predictable SLAs).

-Laura

Laura Bennett
Head of Comms, Redwood Inference

----------------------------------------

On Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:07:12 -0700, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:

Vanessa + team,

Operational points to consider:
- Dedicated roadmap: merging pillars shouldn't delay the dedicated capacity rollout but requires we prioritize kernel selection and batching experiments earlier in the quarter.
- Private deployments: need to confirm resource allocation for on-prem validation runs (I flagged this with infra ops).
- Risk: cross-functional QA timelines might slip by 1-2 sprints; recommend we allocate a short-term QA contract to keep releases on track.

I'll add these into the manager brief and propose a revised timeline slide.

Thanks,
Vivek

----------------------------------------

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy: Pillar realignment + interim role adjustments (Q3 prep)

Quick HR notes: 
- Interim leads: label them "interim" in communications. That helps with expectation setting for compensation and reporting.
- If any people move between managers, we should run a manager-to-manager handoff checklist (I attached a template).
- No immediate comp adjustments needed for interim appointments unless a direct report changes scope >15%.

I'll join the manager briefing to run through manager FAQs.

Neha Kapoor
Director, People Operations

[Attachment: manager_handoff_template.docx (DOCX, 32KB)]

----------------------------------------

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy: Pillar realignment + interim role adjustments (Q3 prep)

Thanks for the quick feedback — finalizing language with Laura's edits. Two quick updates:

- Manager briefing scheduled: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).
- I'll circulate a short FAQ and the updated org chart after the briefing; talking points for managers will include customer impact language (see Laura's suggestion).

External note: Lina from Acme — including you here so your CS lead has visibility while we finalize the customer-facing note; we'll share the customer impact paragraph before the external communication goes out.

Next steps: please confirm any redlines to the attached org chart by Friday, 6 Aug.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: org_chart_v2.pdf (PDF, 160KB)]
